run_train_and_evaluate: run the training loop with a ConfigDict to train and evaluate a nanodo model on a dataset
create_trainer: create a Trainer instance that executes JIT-compiled training steps with gradient accumulation
build_train_state: build a sharded TrainState with Flax module parameters and an optax optimizer
test_checkpoint_manager: test the checkpoint manager that saves and restores model state and data iterators with Orbax
review_restore_ckpt: review the checkpoint restore function that reloads TrainState and data iterator from a checkpoint directory
